lines: Ah ha! A customer! Or a friend! Or both! I'm Otis Gumdrop, toy maker. Everything here's handmade, and only some of it squeaks on purpose.
The festival! The best night of the year, after Christmas Eve, and the day new yo-yos come in.
Have you ridden the hayride? Scarecrow Sam waved at me. I think. Probably the wind.
Testing a new spinning top. Very serious work. (It wobbles and falls over.) Back to the drawing board!

rotate: Have you seen the little clockwork mice? They run in circles. I made them to run in straight lines. They have their own ideas.
When I was a boy, a toy rocket of mine flew right over the old oak and never came down. I still look for it sometimes.
Gizmo was my partner. He made the gizmos, I made the gumdrops. Well, the gumdrop-coloured toys. Gizmo moved to the city. I kept the name.
Every toy needs a name. That bear's called Captain Biscuit. Don't ask him about the war with the rubber ducks.
